1.rule: genuine fall: first fall trial (by trial id) where both systems alert and the proposed alert follows a verified impact within 1 s of the reference impact

2.rule: unseen fall-like ADL: first D10 trial (else any unknown ADL) where the baseline alerts and the proposed does not

3.rule: known ADL: first D01 trial (else any known ADL) where neither system opens an event

4.rule: failure case: first unknown-ADL trial the proposed system still alerts on; else first fall it misses
